content: BCB Manual de Padroes Pix: phone keys in BR Code must be E.164 with plus (+5561...). CPF/CNPJ unpunctuated. Merchant name max 25, city max 15. CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over payload including 6304. Point of initiation 11 static vs 12 dynamic. WhatsApp wa.me wants digits only without plus (55DDDnumero) and URL-encoded text. Mixing the two formats is a common Brazil destination bug.
